title: TransNav: Transformer-Based End-to-End Navigation Method for Static and Dynamic Quadrotor Obstacle Avoidance
venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, vol. 11, no. 11, 2026 (letter), DOI 10.1109/LRA.2026.3734893
description: A question counts as answered at rank r if the r-th retrieved chunk contains ANY of its evidence phrases (case and whitespace insensitive). Evidence phrases are copied from the PDF's own text, not from the parser output, so text lost by the parser shows up as a miss. Questions with no evidence are not answered by the paper; they are used to choose the relevance threshold.

questions.question: Into how many cells is the LiDAR sensing space discretized?
How many patches is the distance map split into?
How often is the reference trajectory sampled over the prediction horizon?
evidence: sampled at regular intervals of 0.05s over the prediction horizon

questions.question: How large is the transformer encoder of the policy?
evidence: a two-layer transformer encoder with two attention heads

questions.question: What happens to the mixed-scenario success rate without temporal gradient decay?
evidence: the success rate in the mixed scenario drops from 80% to 40%

questions.question: How long does one policy inference take on the onboard computer?
How heavy is the real quadrotor?
Why was PPO not used to train the policy?
evidence: PPO fails to train the same action-sequence policy stably

questions.question: How many minutes can the quadrotor fly on one battery?
